newsitem.title: USA: U.S. WEEKLY JOBLESS CLAIMS ROSE IN LATEST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: U.S. WEEKLY JOBLESS CLAIMS ROSE IN LATEST WEEK.

text.p: U.S. Labor Department report of initial state jobless benefit claims, seasonally adjusted.
Week Ended Initial Claims 4-Week Avg. Continued Claims
R-Revised, June 21 continued claims from 2,351,000 and June 14 from 2,270,000.
Wall Street economists had forecast initial jobless claims
The rise in initial jobless claims for the week ended July 5 were driven in part by normal automobile retooling layoffs, the Labor department said.
Auto retooling layoffs have been scheduled for the week of July 4 for the last three years, the agency said.
